To learn Battle Potentials , each character has a unique " Masters Table " , a grid @-@ based skill table that can be used to acquire and link different skills . Players command a military unit through a series of linear missions, each unlocking new maps that can be freely explored and replayed. The game’s story is presented through comic book-style panels featuring animated character portraits, with dialogue delivered via voiced speech bubbles and text.
